attribution: HelpSteer2 and HelpSteer2-Preference, NVIDIA and Scale AI; Zhilin Wang et al.
changes: Full original single-turn texts joined to ratings; deterministic subset and orientation; no excerpts.
eligibility: train; nonzero helpfulness gap and human preference; no <extra_id_1>; prompt <=4000 and each response <=8000 characters
evaluation: Distinct validation rating prompts; exact hash absent from ALL train rating prompts; same character and single-turn prompt filter; no reference answers
selection_hash: sha256(UTF-8('20261007:' + pair_id)); evaluation uses prompt SHA-256 as ID

selectors.gap: descending absolute helpfulness gap, ascending selection hash; helpfulness direction
selectors.human: ascending selection hash from common pool; human label direction
selectors.pareto: correctness+coherence point dominance; ascending selection hash; retain dominance direction
